title: Proposal v1 (generic envelope)
description: Encodes propose != apply as a type. A Proposal is ALWAYS advisory: `requiresHumanReview` is const true, `automatic` const false, `sideEffect` const none. The `payload` carries a domain artifact by reference (`artifact`) and inline (`payload`); the artifact digest must match the canonical digest of `payload` per CONVENTIONS.md. A Proposal grants no authority and effects nothing on its own.

payload.description: The proposed domain artifact, inline. Its canonical digest MUST equal `artifact.digest`. Kept opaque here; the domain schema referenced by `artifact.contractId` is the real validator.
